$comment: Railway topology for the AIOS control plane (ARCHITECTURE §20, §25). Names are Railway service names and private DNS labels (<name>.railway.internal). Per service: <dir>/railway.json (build/deploy) and <dir>/variables.env (Railway variables, references only, never secrets). Read by infra/scripts/railway-plan.sh.

services.name: postgres
services.role: PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector 0.8.7 (same image as local compose); databases aios, litellm (+ langfuse if self-hosted)

services.name: litellm
services.role: model gateway; config rendered at boot from config/litellm/config.template.yaml with the providers whose keys are set

services.name: decision
services.role: Decision Service (Go): Jev, routing policy, budget, escalation; policy files baked into the image

services.name: knowledge
services.role: knowledge base, Context Compiler, memory, MCP for Hermes

services.name: sandbox
services.role: isolated execution for Hermes' terminal (SSH backend, user agent)

services.name: hermes
services.role: Hermes Agent: the only agent runtime (chief gateway, profiles, cron, Kanban, API server)

services.name: edge-gw
services.role: Tailscale gateway (tag:aios-cloud, stable node on a small volume): Railway -> ThinkPad edge :8093 / Ollama :11434; tailnet -> selected Railway ports

services.name: db-backup
services.role: cron: pg_dump -Fc of every database into the aios-backups bucket, pruned after BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS

databases.name: redis
databases.role: Railway Redis template (cache, locks; decision uses DB 1)

buckets.name: aios-backups
buckets.role: db-backup dumps (keep a second copy outside Railway too)
